sources.title: Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models
sources.snippet: It is essential for large language model (LLM) technology to serve many different cultural sub-communities in a manner that is acceptable to each community. However, research on LLM alignment has so far predominantly focused on predicting a unified response preference of annotators from certain regions. This paper aims to advance the development of alignment models with a more global outlook ...

sources.title: Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models
sources.snippet: We focus on the development of reward models for this purpose and present a novel reward model training algorithm (SCPO) that can incorporate diverse cultural preferences in a balanced manner.
